decision: Proceed to controlled integration, not product acceptance or default release

runtime.choice: AgentScope TypeScript 0.0.15 over the existing governed OpenAI SDK Provider
runtime.reason: Actual same-business Function Calling compatibility, tool errors/events managed by maintained Toolkit, turn-local memory only. Domain checks and hard budgets remain server-owned. Replace the Practical handwritten loop, not add a parallel production runtime.
runtime.comparison: SDK 2 requests / 8290ms vs AgentScope 2 requests / 10098ms; same model and synthetic facts. No demonstrated answer-quality advantage. Framework default maxIters permits an extra summary, so a pre-request hard limit is necessary.
runtime.businessFailure: Both answers correctly retained unknown material and exhausted consumables, but then introduced unregistered paper/pen/electronic devices/containers. AgentScope also asked to reconfirm an explicit user report. Preserve both failures; fix the presentation/action boundary before product acceptance.

extraction.choice: Native strict JSON Schema for scoped semantic extraction, not a second answer reviewer
extraction.result: One real official-development source: JSON object returned wrong unknown field type; strict schema met shape, exact quote and scope checks. Both lacked semantic certification; strict output over-cautiously treated a button name as unknown despite text naming Bluetooth button.
extraction.limit: Quote membership is provenance validation, not entailment, complete instructions or real-device verification. Retain source and unread-figure limitations.

instrumentationFailures: AgentScope plain-text content arrays incorrectly rejected locally by pilot guard, corrected and rerun once. Original local failure is not a Qwen request.
Extraction fixture used the wrong local placeholder credential; rejected before upstream. Local protocol stub now checks authentication, route and schemas. No real secret was printed or copied.
JSON-object field validator crashed on an array; fixed defensively and revalidated unchanged original output offline, without extra paid calls.
releaseStatus: NOT_ACCEPTED: Gate2 integration, four App journeys and independent Gate4 quality remain unverified. This review only releases the approved integration budget; it does not waive any gate.
